label: Claude Opus 5.5 (Agency native)
explanation: Rank-1 conditional mode-cancellation edits. Layer 14 linear_attn.out_proj: A = linear detector of the 'user offered a guess' mode at the answer position (built from mean differences, with plain, generic and other-position directions projected out), B = -1.5 x mean (wrong-guess minus plain) residual difference entering layer 15. Layer 15 self_attn.o_proj: A = detector of layer-15 guess-copying, B = -(delta at layer 19 minus delta at layer 15). Patching showed the layer-15 state at the last token controls whether layers 15 and 19 copy the guess. The edits should push that state toward plain-question mode only when a guess is present, so the model answers from its own knowledge. Not tested on the edited model.
